note: Feature areas of the project-tracker contract. Each hidden test is tagged with exactly one area id. `section` is the instruction.md heading that defines the area (section 0, Conventions, applies to every area: its error order, pagination and validation rules are tested inside the areas). `routes` are the routes the area owns, exactly as instruction.md's route tables spell them. `must_cover` lists behaviours the area's tests should reach; every one of them is written in instruction.md. This file is kit-side: it is not copied into the workspace.

areas.title: Accounts and auth
must_cover: register validation (email, password length, name, handle regex) and the user shape without password
email_taken (case-insensitive) before handle_taken
login token >= 20 chars and expiresAt = now + tokenTtlMs; invalid_credentials
401 unauthorized for missing, malformed, unknown, revoked and expired tokens (fake clock)
logout revokes only the calling token
password change: wrong_password; success revokes every token of the user
PATCH /me handle conflict and own-handle no-op

areas.title: Teams and roles
must_cover: creator is owner; myRole per caller; GET /teams lists only the caller's teams
non-members get 404 not_found, never 403, on every team-scoped route
role matrix: viewer/member get 403 on admin+ routes; admin gets 403 on owner routes
add member: user_not_found, already_member, role owner rejected
owner_required on changing or removing the owner
self-removal by a member; removal of someone else by a member is 403
removing a member unassigns their cards
transfer: target becomes owner, previous owner admin, non-member target 400
deleting a team removes it for every member

areas.title: Projects
must_cover: key regex and key_taken within a team (archived included); same key allowed in another team
PATCH with key is 400 invalid_body; updatedAt changes
?archived=false|true|all and invalid_query
archived project: writes to boards, columns, cards and comments answer 409 project_archived; unarchive restores writes
delete cascades (its boards and cards answer 404)

areas.title: Boards and columns
must_cover: default columns To do / In progress / Done with positions 0..2
insert a column at a position; positions stay 0..n-1
move a column with PATCH position; relative order of the others kept
wipLimit validation (null or 1..1000)
delete: last_column, column_not_empty, ?moveTo appends cards in order, invalid moveTo is invalid_query
member is 403 on column and board writes

areas.title: Cards
must_cover: card shape; number per project across boards, never reused after delete; key PROJECT-N
labels normalised: trimmed, lowercased, de-duplicated, sorted; more than 10 is 400
dueDate validation including impossible dates
assignee: viewer, non-member and unknown id are invalid_assignee; null clears
create at a position shifts later cards; delete closes the gap
move across columns and within a column with exact resulting positions
move to another board's column is 400 invalid_body
wip_limit_reached on create and on move into a full column; reorder inside a full column allowed
GET /boards/:boardId/cards order and ?columnId= filter; foreign columnId is invalid_query
viewer gets 403 on card writes

areas.title: Comments and mentions
must_cover: threaded replies returned as nested trees, oldest first, any depth
parentId on another card is 400 invalid_body
mention regex edge cases: email addresses, uppercase, punctuation, 21-char names, non-members, the author
mentions recomputed on PATCH
PATCH by a non-author (even the owner) is 403; DELETE by admin allowed, by another member 403
soft delete keeps replies; PATCH/DELETE/reply on a deleted comment is comment_deleted
GET /me/mentions newest first with cursor pagination

areas.title: Search
must_cover: prefix term matching over title, description and non-deleted comments; every term must match
score 3*t + d + c and its tie-break by creation order
filters: projectId, boardId, columnId, assigneeId and none, repeated label, dueFrom/dueTo inclusive
archived projects excluded unless includeArchived=true
cursor pagination visits every match once; total; invalid limit/cursor/date/includeArchived are invalid_query
q longer than 200 chars or with more than 10 terms is invalid_query
results never include another team's cards

areas.title: Webhooks
must_cover: secret only on create and rotate; generated secret >= 32 chars
events validation, de-dup and sort, * normalisation
a local receiver gets the payload with the documented headers; signature verifies with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body
every documented event fires with its data; events filter respected; inactive webhooks get nothing but ping
retry with small retryDelaysMs: a receiver answering 500 then 200 gives attempts 2 and succeeded; same body bytes, attempt header increments
exhausted retries give failed; a timeout gives a non-empty lastError and lastStatusCode null
deliveries newest first; member gets 403 on webhook routes

areas.title: Rate limiting
must_cover: headers x-ratelimit-limit, -remaining, -reset on counted requests (fake clock)
429 rate_limited with retry-after and remaining 0, and no side effect
429s are not counted; budget per token, not per user
a new window (clock moved) restores the budget
public routes and 401s carry no headers and are not counted

areas.title: Persistence (version 2 data file)
must_cover: the file exists and is version 2 right after a mutating response (no debounce)
a new app on the same file sees everything: logins, unexpired and revoked tokens, ids, positions, next card number
no plain-text password in the file
missing file is an empty state
createApp throws on invalid JSON and on an unsupported version

areas.title: Migration from the 1.x format
must_cover: v1.bak byte-identical and dataFile rewritten as version 2 before createApp returns
migrated users log in with their 1.x passwords; emails lowercased; derived handles including collisions and short handles
role mapping manager/editor/reader and member order
columns, wipLimit from limits, orphan column cards land in the first column, positions from order with ties
labels from tags, dueDate from UTC timestamps, assignee dropped for viewers and non-members
card numbers per project by createdAt with ties in file order; next card number continues
comment parentId kept only for the same card; mentions recomputed with migrated handles
areas.fixture: input/fixtures/tracker-v1.json (hidden tests must carry their own copy, since the agent can edit the workspace)

areas.title: Audit log
must_cover: one entry per successful write with the documented action, target and details
failed requests, reads and cascades add nothing
fields in *.updated details are the sorted body fields
newest first with cursor pagination; action and actorId filters
member and viewer get 403
